📖 The dash has two jobs. Learn both.

The dash has two different jobs, and the SAT tests both.

✅ Job 1: one dash works like a colon.
✅ Job 2: two dashes wrap removable info.
✅ One dash: full sentence first. Two dashes: a matching pair.
